newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS calls alliance news conference May 14.
newsitem.headline: SAS calls alliance news conference May 14.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) officially announced on Monday that it would hold a news conference on multilateral cooperation plans with its strategic allies including Germany's Lufthansa in Frankfurt on May 14.
"The management of SAS, United Airlines, Lufthansa, Thai Airways and Air Canada will at a news conference on May 14 publish plans to establish a multilateral alliance," SAS said in a statement.

The five carriers all have bilateral cooperation agreements at present and the plan is that these pacts shall be made multilateral, without any ownership changes being made and with the individual airlines all keeping their own identity, SAS said.

There has been speculation in recent months about a possible expansion of the five allied airlines' partnership to form a global alliance to challenge a planned British Airways and American Airlines linkup. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
